description: Take a screenshot and return the image to you. An image costs you roughly 1,000-1,600 tokens, so use it when you need to SEE something: visual or frontend work, layout and styling, charts, images, canvas. For facts on a page prefer browser_ask or browser_read; to act, prefer browser_capabilities. fullPage stitches the whole scrollable page, including anything off the right edge (costs more). ref or selector captures a single element whole, even one wider or taller than the viewport.

format.description: jpeg (default, small) or png (sharper text, much larger).

fullPage.description: Capture the whole scrollable page, not just the viewport.

ref.description: Capture only this element (a ref from browser_capabilities).

selector.description: Capture only the first element matching this CSS selector.

name: browser_screenshot
title: See the page
